description.en: Advances the character movement manager by one step: for each of its 16 slots, a slot whose character no longer exists is freed, and the move or turn in progress is updated. CallEvent calls it once per frame; QuickTurn calls it when asked to (_ev_step). Scripts that wait on moves outside CallEvent call it themselves.

examples.case: Waiting for turns in the NPC event (real usage, from ev43010000.nut)
